name: Olimpbet
note: Betting brand; official partner of several KHL clubs (CSKA, Severstal, Spartak, Sochi, Amur) and of SKA per the archived club site. Ownership not traced: the operator is ООО «БК Олимп» (Moscow); bookmaker-ratings.ru (2020) reported an offshore parent was replaced by a Russian legal entity, but the ultimate owners are not publicly documented.
